output.technical_predicate: For an accepted contract, the four borrower-provided fields (email, amount, term, income) are returned as machine-readable structured data to the borrower and, on request, transmitted to the selected local receiving controller; inferred decisions are excluded.
applicability_facts: Scenario: automated processing of a current contract; borrower supplied email, amount, term and income (all four are provided data, not inferred).
Scenario: borrower downloads those fields and requests direct transfer to the feasible local receiver.
store.py:0036-0038 persists email, amount, term, income on the case row; store.py:0077-0078 stores them from the application form.
app.py:0100-0109 serves GET /case/<id>/portable as application/json with Content-Disposition attachment, gated to the owner (app.py:0105).
store.py:0201-0204 implements the 'transfer' action writing portable(c) to the receiver table for destination 'Local Credit Union'.
views.py:0069-0070 exposes the portable download and transfer controls only when stage=='accepted'.
relevant_exceptions: store.py:0115 requires stage=='accepted' (409 otherwise) — consistent with the contract-stage precondition, not an exemption.
app.py:0105 requires the requester to be the case owner (403 for officers) — recipient restriction, not an exemption.
store.py:0202 restricts transfer destination to 'Local Credit Union' — the scenario's feasible local receiver.
No exception in the supplied source removes the four fields from portability; no inferred decision field is included in portable().
required_controls: Machine-readable export: JSON serialization of the portable payload (app.py:0107-0109, mime application/json).
Completeness of the four provided fields: portable() must return email, amount, term and income (store.py:0116).
Exclusion of inferred decisions: portable() must not include stage/decision/confirmed-band or other derived outcomes.
Borrower-only access to the export (app.py:0105) and accepted-stage gating (store.py:0115).
Direct transfer on request to the selected local receiver, persisting the same portable payload (store.py:0201-0204).
assessment_limits: Static source reading only; no execution, no runtime verification of responses or receiver contents.

store.py:0116 returns only email, amount and income — 'term' is absent from portable(), so the four-field completeness control is not satisfied by the supplied source; the transfer path (store.py:0203) reuses the same incomplete payload.
Whether the scenario's case is actually in stage 'accepted' is a scenario fact, not verified against a database.
No assessment of other GDPR articles, of the receiver's onward handling, or of legal deadlines beyond the named rule.
